description: Satellite imagery, captured by Spot 5 on 2010-09-07 with a 2.5 m resolution (3/4/2 band combination), depicts a glaciated, mountainous landscape in the Kebnekaise region of Sweden. Prominent white areas represent glaciers and perpetual snow. Deep blue areas indicate meltwater lakes or rivers, visible particularly in the upper left. The surrounding terrain shows variations in blue-green and reddish-brown hues, characteristic of bare rock or sparse vegetation. A faint yellow delineation, corresponding to a CORINE Land Cover (CLC) classification and aligning with a Protected Area (PA) boundary, is visible around the main glacier masses. The image is credited to CNES 2011©, Distribution Airbus DS/Spot Image.
